changes.name: STILL, ALMOST MOVING II
changes.principle: A fixed110/220Hz harmonic relationship changes partial overlap and density, without foreground note sequencing.
changes.tradeoff: Two fewer modules. The upper source is quieter and nearer harmonic partials; drift/mass and slowly smoothed WARP around its harmonic center create internal development rather than a melody.

changes.name: PIXEL DUST
changes.principle: The collection's intentionally familiar, dry eight-note pentatonic melody.
changes.tradeoff: Preserved byte-for-byte: existing rare gate omissions, later BRANCH memory changes and PENDULUM colour already supply modest variation.

changes.name: ROOM AIR
changes.principle: Original nonmetrical room presence, with a minimal +12dB LEVEL proposal.
changes.tradeoff: One gain-only module; no low-cut, compression or source/timing/spatial edits. Low-frequency room weight remains. Review at matched playback levels before accepting this gain choice.

changes.name: SMALL HOURS
changes.principle: Irregular autonomous fragments, sample-feature recency and returning MIRAGE memory, with no explicit beat.
changes.tradeoff: One fewer module. CUTS now controls event spacing; intervals are bounded but seeded, and MIRAGE/NERVE/LOSS retain contextual memory. No fixed phrase is promised.

changes.name: EXCHANGING BODIES
changes.principle: A longer ringing body and a shorter responding body interact under3:2 companion timing; the first physically excites the second.
changes.tradeoff: One net additional module. No bell melody; two materials share a nominal110Hz root with slowly changing coupling. The reply is also excited by the first body between its own strikes.

changes.name: DISSOLVING METAL
changes.principle: Unequal7.3s three-plateau motion and an independent strike clock produce imperfect near-unisons/fifth-like intervals.
changes.tradeoff: Same module count. Approximate held targets220/329/229Hz are not a conventional scale. TOUCH transitions and existing ALLOY continuous-pitch tracking also retune overlapping tails; interference is intentional, listening still required.

changes.name: BINARY FEVER
changes.principle: Seven-in-twelve articulation interacts with a three-times-longer reset pattern and an audio-rate binary divider.
changes.tradeoff: One fewer module; OSC/FERAL pitch is fixed. Counter resets can change the waveform at an accent; existing MAP/filtering and bounded levels remain. Rhythm replaces melodic variety.

changes.name: TAPE GARDEN
changes.principle: A two-tone tritone family becomes finite gestures; worn delayed memory supplies the returns.
changes.tradeoff: Two net additional modules. Continuous upper melody is replaced by155.6/220Hz gestures, separated from approximately.484s echoes; original tape/space colour remains.

changes.name: LATE LIGHT
changes.principle: Four held interval positions become related through PLATE overlap, with slower uneven arrivals and missing events.
changes.tradeoff: One net additional module. The arithmetic cycle is four states, not eight notes; longer gaps retain openness. The four pitches are approximately370/440/554/311Hz, with no root-to-root phrase closure.

changes.name: OFF GRID
changes.principle: Asymmetric12-step time samples moving physical coordinates onto19-TET; the second clock stream disturbs the motion.
changes.tradeoff: Same module count. Held physical pitch replaces the pentatonic source. Every WEFT A event now articulates directly instead of BRANCH probabilistically omitting some; narrower span and existing long fall preserve space.
